title: Prelude of Foundation Models (early deep learning)
reading: The slide traces the early deep learning era that preceded foundation models, anchored on the ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge and a succession of landmark CNN architectures cited as Krizhevsky et al. 2012 (AlexNet), Simonyan et al. 2015 (VGG), Szegedy et al. 2015 (GoogLeNet/Inception), He et al. 2016 (ResNet) and Huang et al. 2017 (DenseNet). A human error-rate marker of 0.05 is shown next to the ImageNet montage, and red arrows chain the architectures together.

visuals.description: A montage of ImageNet images labelled 'ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenges', a green bar reading 0.05 labelled 'human', and four network architecture schematics (AlexNet, VGG, GoogLeNet, ResNet-34, DenseNet) connected by ascending red arrows.
visuals.assertion: Successive ImageNet-era CNN architectures grew progressively deeper and drove error toward and past the ~0.05 human benchmark.
